title: 三星84万亿扩产：90%投向芯片，设备链紧张，产出能跟上吗？
speaker: Sanjeev Rana

segments.en: Lightly in a through 2030 in our view. OK, well, we'll talk about more in a memory in a moment.
segments.zh: 我们认为到2030年轻微增长。好的，我们稍后再讨论内存。

segments.en: But just related to that is the Capix number. They came out with 84 trillion.
segments.zh: 与此相关的是资本支出数字。他们公布了84万亿。

segments.en: We were in the mid 50s last year. 90% of the 84 is in chips.
segments.zh: 去年我们是50多。84万亿中90%用于芯片。

segments.en: What do you make of that number? Is that number big enough to satisfy?
segments.zh: 你怎么看这个数字？这个数字足够满足需求吗？

segments.en: I think to quench the thirst for their products on memory?
segments.zh: 我认为是为了满足他们对内存产品的需求？

segments.en: I think the company is doing whatever it can, but it's not a problem where you can just simply throw the money.
segments.zh: 我认为公司正在尽其所能，但这不是简单砸钱就能解决的问题。

segments.en: Because the whole equipment supply chain right from ASML to semiconductor material providers, the whole chain is very much stretched.
segments.zh: 因为整个设备供应链，从ASML到半导体材料供应商，整个链条非常紧张。

segments.en: Every semiconductor company is looking to expand capacity significantly in the next three to five years.
segments.zh: 每家半导体公司都计划在未来三到五年大幅扩产。

segments.en: So because there is so much demand. So Samsung raising Capix just suggests that there is a lot of demand out there.
segments.zh: 因为需求如此之大。所以三星提高资本支出表明市场存在大量需求。

segments.en: But also there are some constraints on equipment availability that are likely to affect their output growth in the coming years.
segments.zh: 但设备供应也存在一些限制，可能影响他们未来几年的产出增长。
